meta.title: Online enrolment
meta.description: Choose your course, hold your seat and send your payment receipt in four steps.

footer.secure: Secure connection. Your data is used only for your enrolment.

course.title: What would you like to study?
course.subtitle: Pick the language, the course, the start date and the schedule. The price appears once you choose a schedule.
course.catalog_empty: There are no groups with open enrollment right now. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll let you know as soon as seats open.
course.start_date_hint: The same course opens on several dates. Choose when you want to begin, then the schedule.
course.schedules_on_date: {count, plural, one {# schedule available} other {# schedules available}}
course.no_start_dates: No start dates are open for this course right now. Message us on WhatsApp and we will let you know when the next cycle opens.
course.group_hint: Schedules available on that start date. Every class is online, on Google Meet, and the schedule stays the same for the whole module.
course.no_groups: No schedules are open for this course right now. Message us on WhatsApp and we will let you know when the next cycle opens.
course.seats_left: {count, plural, one {# seat left} other {# seats left}}
course.single_payment_note: One single payment. No monthly fees, no instalments.

student.title: Who is going to study?
student.subtitle: These details go on your certificate, so write them exactly as they appear on your ID.
student.full_name_hint: Exactly as it appears on your ID. This is how it will read on your certificate.
student.phone_hint: Mobile number so we can reach you about your enrolment.
student.min_age_hint: This course is for ages {age} and up.
student.email_hint: It must be the student’s own Gmail account. Institutional and corporate addresses are not accepted: class access arrives through Google Classroom.
student.guardian_subtitle: The student is under 18, so we need their guardian's details and consent.
student.consent_label: I authorise the minor's enrolment and the processing of their personal data for academic purposes.
student.consent_version: Consent text version {version}. We record the date and time you accepted.

verify.title: Verify your e-mail
verify.intro: We will send a 6-digit code to {email}. That is how we confirm the address exists and is yours: class access and your enrollment notices arrive there.
verify.sent: We sent a code to {email}. It can take up to a minute; check your spam folder too.
verify.resend_in: You can ask for another code in {seconds} s
verify.required: Verify your e-mail with the code to continue.
verify.fill_email_first: Type a valid Gmail address to receive the code.
verify.captcha_hint: Complete the security check to send the code.

error.code_invalid: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
error.code_expired: That code expired or was replaced by a newer one. Ask for another code.
error.attempts_exhausted: Too many tries with this code. Ask for another code.
error.not_found: We have not sent a code to this address yet. Ask for one.
error.cooldown: We just sent you a code. Wait a moment before asking for another.
error.too_many_sends: We already sent several codes for this enrollment. Check the address is right, or message us on WhatsApp.
error.captcha_failed: The security check expired or was not accepted. Complete it again.
error.captcha_unavailable: We could not load the security check. Reload the page; if it persists, turn off your ad blocker.
error.rate_limited: We received too many attempts from your connection. Wait a few minutes.
error.invalid_email: Check the address: it must be a valid Gmail account.
error.failed: We could not complete that. Try again.

payment.title: Pay and upload your receipt
payment.subtitle: You pay from your bank or Yape app. Here we only receive the proof.
payment.amount_hint: This is the package price in force. We do not apply discounts.
payment.exact_amount_warning: Pay the exact amount. A different amount goes to manual review and delays your enrolment.
payment.proof_hint: Upload the screenshot or voucher of the payment. Without a receipt we cannot register your enrolment.
payment.operation_hint: It appears on your payment record as the operation number.
payment.receipt_preview_alt: Preview of the receipt you uploaded

review.title: Check before sending
review.subtitle: If anything is wrong, you can fix it from here.
review.what_happens: When you send, your seat is held and your receipt goes to review. You have up to {days} days for the payment to be approved; we will email you as soon as it is.
review.submit_failed: We could not submit your enrollment. You can try again — it will not create a duplicate seat.
review.operation_number_used: That operation number was already used for another enrollment. Check it on the payment step; if it is right, message us on WhatsApp.
review.invalid_fields: We couldn't register your enrollment: check these details and send again.
review.captcha_hint: Complete the security check to submit your enrollment.
review.captcha_failed: The security check expired or was not accepted. Complete it again and resubmit.
review.captcha_unavailable: We could not load the security check. Reload the page; if it keeps happening, turn off your ad blocker or message us on WhatsApp.
review.rate_limited: We received too many attempts from your connection. Wait a few minutes and submit again — your details and your seat are still here.
review.email_unverified: We need to verify the student's e-mail before sending. Go back to the student step and type the code.

hold.will_start: When you continue we hold your seat for {minutes} minutes so you can pay without rushing.
hold.active: Your seat is held while you pay
hold.remaining: {minutes} minutes and {seconds} seconds left on your hold
hold.full: That schedule just filled up. Pick another schedule or another date.
hold.failed: We could not hold your seat. Check your connection and try again.

expired.title: Time ran out
expired.body: Your seat went back to the class group and this enrolment was cancelled. You can start again and pick your schedule.
expired.already_paid: Already paid? Do not pay again. Message us on WhatsApp with your receipt and operation number and we will register it for you.

error.national_id_format: Check the number: a DNI has 8 digits; a foreigner's card, 9 to 12 letters or digits; a passport, 6 to 12.
error.email_mismatch: The two addresses do not match.
error.email_must_be_gmail: It must be a Gmail account. Institutional and corporate addresses are not accepted.
error.email_gmail_username_invalid: That Gmail address cannot exist: the username must be 6–30 characters, only letters, numbers and dots (no “+”, no dot at the start or end, no two dots in a row).
error.min_age: This course has a higher minimum age. Choose another course or message us.
error.consent_required: We need the guardian's authorisation to continue.
error.operation_format: The operation number is between 6 and 20 characters.
error.receipt_required: Upload your payment receipt to continue.
error.receipt_type: Upload an image (JPG, PNG or HEIC).
error.receipt_size: That file is too large. Try a lighter screenshot.
error.receipt_upload_failed: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
error.fix_fields: Please check the highlighted fields before continuing.
error.too_long: This is too long. Please shorten it.

submitted.title: We have your enrolment
submitted.subtitle: We will send an email to {email} with the result of your payment review.

received.title: We received your receipt
received.body: Your seat is held in your name.

review.title: We review your payment
review.body: We check the amount and the operation number. Your seat is held for up to {days} days while we do.

credentials.title: We send your access
credentials.body: Once the payment is approved, you will get your credentials and the class link by email.

submitted.online_note: All our classes are 100% online, on Google Meet and Google Classroom. You never need to travel to a campus.
